notes: Power line conditioner / surge protector, not a signal-routing AV device. "Power conditioner" is not in the allowed type enum, so type is set to PDU (closest fit: rack-mountable AC power distribution/protection unit). Official Panamax "Model MR4300 Reference Guide" (DIN-00015 REV. C) panel diagram confirms: front panel has 1 convenience AC outlet, USB Type-A charger (0.5A/5V), volt meter, power/bank indicators (not physical ports). Back panel has 8 switched AC outlets in two banks of 4 (Bank 2 = High Current, Bank 1 = Linear Filtration), an 8 ft. permanently-attached (captive) power cord with 45-degree low-profile NEMA 5-15 plug (no IEC inlet on the chassis), a ground lug, 1 pair RJ-45 in/out (LAN, 10/100/1000baseT), 1 pair RJ-11 in/out (telephone), and 2 pairs F-type coax in/out (CATV/SAT 1 and CATV/SAT 2, 0 MHz-2.2GHz, bidirectional passive surge-protected pass-through). The 9 protected AC outlets (1 front + 8 rear) are receptacles that pass through conditioned/filtered power to connected gear; modeled here as NEMA-5-15 outputs since no closer connector id exists for a US duplex outlet. Ethernet and coax pairs are physically separate IN and OUT jacks (surge-protection pass-through), not a single bidirectional port, so each is listed as a distinct input and output. Ethernet grade set to eth-1g reflecting stated 10/100/1000baseT compatibility. TEL (RJ-11) ports modeled with rj45 connector id as the closest available match since RJ-11 is missing from the connector list; noted as a caveat. Desktop/rack-convertible unit: 17"W x 6"D x 1.75"H, rack-mountable with optional (not included) rack ears — modeled as 1U given its 1.75" height and rack-mount capability.
